findings.headline: Move this onCleanup out of the createEffect callback into the apply callback's returned cleanup.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 requires this one-argument createEffect to split into compute and apply callbacks, and the apply callback takes cleanup as a returned function that runs before the next apply and on disposal.
findings.guidance: When splitting the effect, move the work this cleanup undoes into the apply callback and return the cleanup function from it, keeping the cleanup's reads in the apply half; drop the onCleanup wrapper.

findings.headline: Move this onCleanup out of the onMount callback into onSettled's returned cleanup.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 replaces onMount with onSettled, whose callback takes cleanup as a returned function; onCleanup is rejected inside onSettled (CLEANUP_IN_FORBIDDEN_SCOPE).
findings.guidance: When this onMount becomes onSettled, return the cleanup function from the onSettled callback instead of registering it with onCleanup; if the callback already returns something, combine both into one returned cleanup.
